summary: EMMIR is an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in migration and intercultural relations, based in Oldenburg, Germany, and is accepting applications for Edition 14 (2027-2029). It is for students who want a master's degree in migration studies and intercultural relations. Applicants for an Erasmus Mundus scholarship or a non-fee-paying self-funded place must apply by 20 December 2026 at 23:59 CET; fee-paying self-funded applications stay open until 15 July 2027.
